rationale: Across all demonstrations, the five-pixel plus becomes 1, the three-pixel L with rows 10/11 becomes 2, the 2x2 square becomes 3, the horizontal three-pixel line becomes 4, the vertical three-pixel line becomes 5, and the T with rows 111/010 becomes 6. Each exact template scores 0.5; any missing or extra pixel reduces its score by 1.
